conditionalConstantHazardDiagnostic.derivation: If P(jackpot|stake)=k*stake with k constant across jackpot values and the meter resets to zero while 0.60% of wagers funds the pool, hit meter amounts are exponential with mean contributionDecimal/k. Therefore breakEvenJackpot/meanHit=(1-baseRtp)/contributionDecimal.
conditionalConstantHazardDiagnostic.interpretation: Even under the favorable conditional model, a pool whose mean hit were near the one observed candidate would need to be around EUR 10.4k before the instantaneous total RTP reaches 100%. The observed candidate near EUR 1.2k is not an entry signal.

blockingFacts: One synchronized reset is not enough to estimate a hit distribution.
The synchronized Tiki/Alice reset does not independently prove that a jackpot award occurred.
The exact live Winfall pool identity is not yet verified.
Published proportionality to Total Bet does not alone prove k is constant across jackpot values.
No current fresh meter may be used from the stale 2026-08-21 snapshot.
